purpose: Measure incremental case-review usefulness; anomaly scores are not fraud probabilities

scope.other_case_types: Keep baseline selection/order; report missing or out-of-scope score coverage
scope.initial_candidate_universe: Existing eligible case snapshots shared by both arms; no ML-only admission

data_and_model_requirements.incompatible_model_action: Reject; do not stamp new provenance onto an old artifact
data_and_model_requirements.missing_case_scores_action: Retain baseline order and report missing coverage; never substitute zero

comparison.baseline: Frozen current rules + graph + A5 ordering and admission policy
comparison.candidate: Keep baseline mandatory selected slots; rank remaining cases by IF only within the same priority band
comparison.case_if_aggregation: Maximum valid member score known by the daily cutoff, before candidate selection
comparison.ties: Baseline order, then stable case identifier
comparison.mandatory_overflow: Record overflow under the same agreed baseline policy; do not silently hide mandatory cases
comparison.per_arm_study_ledger: Track completed and awaiting-information scopes separately; never write production feedback
comparison.unchanged_completed_scope: Do not count the same completed case scope again as new benefit on another day
comparison.changed_case_scope: Require a separate review; do not migrate an old conclusion automatically

review_design.reference_sample_purpose: Assess selection bias and coverage; not automatic negatives or a third alert arm

metrics: Actionable reviewed cases / reviewed selected cases, separately by arm and company
Absolute actionable-case gain and count displaced within the same daily budget
Missing-evidence counts and share, including unresolved outcomes
Measured review minutes and useful cases per measured review hour
Backlog and delay for displaced cases; mandatory-slot preservation
IF score coverage and fallback share
Scope-size distribution because maximum member score can favor larger cases
rollback: Keep baseline selection active; discard or archive shadow suggestions without changing case conclusions
holdout_005_policy: Never load, score or tune on 005 in this preparation; opaque preservation hashing only
